title: SMTP Notifier for password-reset emails
description: v1 ships only LogNotifier (backend/src/notifier.rs) which writes the reset URL (with token) to the server log. Implement an SMTP Notifier behind the existing Notifier trait (env: SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASSWORD/FROM), select it in AppState::new when configured, keep LogNotifier as the dev fallback. Send from a spawned task so the forgot-password response time stays constant. PRD §4.2 lists this as a follow-up.

title: Unicode-aware case-insensitive search for admin q filters
description: Admin students/orders q (PRD §5.4.11) uses SQLite LIKE, which folds case for ASCII only (e.g. 'É' vs 'é' won't match). Acceptable for v1 (spec literally says LIKE). If needed later: store a lowercased search column or register a Unicode lower() function on the pool.
